# Tool reference (generated by `./h docs`; `*` = required)

Same tools through MCP and `./h call`. Which list you get is set by HARNESS_MODE in harness.env.

## Transformer / MLP mode (HARNESS_MODE=llm)
- `inventory` (no arguments)
  Every editable component (blocks, heads, MLP banks, matrices with guessed roles) and the op that edits it.
- `pairs_check` (file*:string, ckpt:string)
  Quality-check clean/corrupt prompt pairs in a JSON file (equal length, model prefers `correct` on clean, corruption hurts). Returns which pairs are usable and why others are not.
- `circuit` (file*:string, name*:string, top_frac:number, edges:boolean, ckpt:string)
  Find the circuit for one behaviour: exact patching of every head and MLP unit over the usable pairs, t-stat + sign-agreement selection, faithfulness. edges=true adds edge attribution checked against exact edge patching. Saves it under `name`.
- `grow` (file*:string, name*:string, target:number, top_frac:number, baseline:string)
  (optional arg `baseline`: name of a baseline map whose co-active neighbours are offered as extra growth candidates.) Grow a circuit until keeping ONLY it clean recovers `target` of the behaviour (necessary -> sufficient). Adds upstream writers (exact edge patching), whole MLP banks and single nodes, then prunes. Saves it under `name`.
- `baseline` (name*:string, n:integer, where:string, min_corr:number)
  Map what lights up on NORMAL in-distribution prompts: per-layer dead / always-on units and clusters of units that co-activate. Correlational, not causal; read it as a starting map.
- `neighbors` (name*:string, circuit*:string, file:string, min_corr:number, k:integer)
  Units that co-activate with a saved circuit (candidate connective tissue). With `file` (pairs) the candidates are verified: informative only if adding them beats the same number of random units.
- `union` (names*:string, min_frac:number)
  Macro circuit: nodes present in at least min_frac of several saved circuits (build the circuits from different related prompt sets).
- `overlap` (names*:string)
  Compare saved circuits: Jaccard, nodes shared by all behaviours, nodes specific to each.
- `proposals` (name*:string, gamma:number)
  Turn a saved circuit's nodes into ready-to-propose edit configs (edit ONLY circuit nodes).
- `weights` (matrix*:string, rows:string, cols:string)
  RAW weights of any matrix/parameter slice (<=4000 values). rows/cols as 'a:b'.
- `diff` (a*:string, b*:string, top:integer)
  Per-matrix relative weight change between two checkpoints (ints 0..9 or 'final').
- `list_ops` (no arguments)
  The edit ops with every argument's allowed range for THIS model. Read it before proposing.
- `note` (kind*:string, text*:string)
  Write a research note to the ledger (before and after every charged evaluation).
- `screen` (op*:string, cfg*:object)
  FREE (uncharged) trial of one edit on research episodes, separate from the data the judge uses. Returns d_success with CI. Capped per run; use it to pick what to spend a charged proposal on.
- `sweep` (op*:string, cfg*:object, param*:string, values*:array)
  FREE strength sweep: one op, one numeric parameter (e.g. gamma, or a dotted path like ops.1.cfg.gamma for a composite), 2-9 values. Returns the curve on research episodes and the best value. Each value uses one screen.
- `propose` (op*:string, cfg*:object)
  CHARGED evaluation of one edit against the unedited model on the selection set (rejected proposals are charged too). Returns d_success, CI, id_drop, accepted.
- `status` (no arguments)
  Budget left and ledger integrity.
- `state` (no arguments)
  Compact digest of this run (budget, best charged edit, history, your notes). Use it to resume after a context reset.

## Nav2D mode (default)
- `inventory` (no arguments)
  List every editable component (feedforward banks, attention-head groups, embeddings, output head) with the op that edits it.
- `neuron_scan` (block*:string, top:integer)
  Rank MLP neurons of one block by label-free memorisation contrast (train labels vs expert behaviour on held-out scenarios). Larger = more memorisation-like.
- `circuit` (top:integer)
  EXACT edge-removal contrast over the residual graph (slow, ~90 s). Read the two damage columns, not only the contrast.
- `heads` (top:integer)
  How actions are produced: declared action heads (base/nudge/expert) if the model exposes them, else decoder readouts and the exact per-writer split.
- `diff` (a*:string, b*:string, top:integer)
  Per-module weight change and action change between two checkpoints (ints 0..9 or 'final').
- `weights` (matrix*:string, rows:string, cols:string)
  RAW weights of any matrix/parameter slice (<=4000 values). rows/cols as 'a:b'. If it answers raw_view DISABLED the run is the summary-only arm.
- `qkv` (kind*:string, layer*:integer, head*:integer, dump:boolean)
  One attention head: Wq/Wk/Wv/Wo norms, QK and OV circuit spectra, most-read input dims, exact edit handles; dump=true adds raw slices.
- `attention` (kind*:string, layer*:integer, head*:integer, set:string)
  Mean query x key attention of one head, entropy, example patterns.
- `activity` (kind*:string, layer*:integer)
  MLP unit activations on train vs held-out states; lists the units that behave most differently.
- `list_ops` (no arguments)
  The edit ops with every argument's allowed range for THIS model. Read it before proposing.
- `probe` (op*:string, cfg*:object)
  FREE research probe of one edit: teacher-forced L1 change on a research set (negative = closer to the expert). Not closed-loop success. 30 per run.
- `note` (kind*:string, text*:string)
  Write a research note to the ledger (do this before and after every charged evaluation).
- `screen` (op*:string, cfg*:object)
  FREE (uncharged) trial of one edit on research episodes, separate from the data the judge uses. Returns d_success with CI. Capped per run; use it to pick what to spend a charged proposal on.
- `sweep` (op*:string, cfg*:object, param*:string, values*:array)
  FREE strength sweep: one op, one numeric parameter (e.g. gamma, or a dotted path like ops.1.cfg.gamma for a composite), 2-9 values. Returns the curve on research episodes and the best value. Each value uses one screen.
- `propose` (op*:string, cfg*:object)
  CHARGED evaluation of one edit against the unedited model on the selection set (rejected proposals are charged too). Returns d_success, CI, id_drop, accepted.
- `status` (no arguments)
  Budget left and ledger integrity.
- `state` (no arguments)
  Compact digest of this run (budget, best charged edit, history, recent probes, your notes). Use it to resume after a context reset.
